all_executed_cases.error: Interrupted by explicit user request to stop WSL; subsequent permission requires bounded resources.

role: VLA selects the instructed person from RGB and generates approach/stop velocity; detection independently confirms discovery. Conventional control stabilizes velocity and attitude.
comparison: Both models use the same new navfocus controller and English prompts. The video retains v1.0 with its original controller and bilingual prompts. These are distinct conditions.
limitations: Same room and two static avatar identities; bounded unseen layouts, not arbitrary environments.
VLA does not emit a separate person detection label. Recognition is tested through visual/language interventions and target-directed actions.
The VLA receives stage instructions, not the upper-level Japanese search command.
The contribution of individual training changes and language adaptation is not isolated.
Stationary phases override horizontal VLA requests with zero; approach phases execute bounded VLA horizontal requests.
No real aircraft flight or unknown-room claim.
